items.title: Clarence Ford Interview, 1975-12-10
items.q: the first band is the guy that said Melvin Lasty, Wilbur Hogan played trumpet, Wilbur Hogan played drums

ctx.x: So who was in Joe Jones' band at first?
Oh, the first band is the guy that said Melvin Lasty, Wilbur Hogan played trumpet, Wilbur Hogan played drums, he's dead now. He's got a brother that's a very good pianist.
